answer.label: Attributed to
answer.sourceLine: The sentence is credited to Dawkins’s 1992 Edinburgh International Science Festival remarks and an April 1992 Independent article. The exact words are reproduced by Wikiquote and a scholarly review, but the original newspaper page or recording was not inspected in this check.

author.name: Richard Dawkins
author.heading: About Richard Dawkins
author.bio: Richard Dawkins brought gene-centered accounts of evolution to a broad readership through books such as The Selfish Gene and The Blind Watchmaker. His public writing also attacks religious belief and creationism, a different role from presenting biological research.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The sentence expresses Dawkins’s polemical distinction between evidence-based inquiry and the kind of belief he calls faith. Its circulation in debates about religion does not make it a quotation from The God Delusion: the documentary references point to 1992, before that book’s publication.
